## One move

::: {.explain-code}
```{.go}
// <noshow>
package main
// </noshow>
row := b.freeRow(col) // <line=find>
// exit: early
check(row)
b.cells[row][col] = p // <line=place>
```

:::: {lines="find" mark="find:row"}

::::

:::: {lines="place" mark="place:col"}

::::
